answer: Each epoch, every agent must publish a verifiable delay function output seeded by the fresh beacon, a sequential squaring chain that takes one full core about five hours and cannot be parallelized, like a pearl grown layer by layer. Proofs verify in milliseconds at the wharf of validators, so a gale of clones gains nothing: an attacker running 1000 identities must keep 1000 dedicated cores busy all epoch, paying real hardware and power for each.
